description: Style upgrade: make search field, results list, and sidecar match the existing liquid-glass window with a premium dark, calm, highly readable panel system (subtle strokes, refined selection, low-cost glow), respecting macOS accessibility settings.

userStories.title: Introduce premium panel system for header/results/sidecar
userStories.description: As a user, I want the search header, results list, and sidecar to share a cohesive premium dark panel style so the UI feels unified and elegant.
acceptanceCriteria: Search header, results area, and sidecar use a shared panel background + subtle stroke
Corner radius is consistent (~18–20) and padding increased for a premium feel
Text remains highly readable on the new surfaces
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Implemented premium panel system with corner radius 18-20, subtle strokes (0.5px), increased padding, and cohesive styling across header/results/sidecar. All snapshot tests updated and passing.

userStories.title: Upgrade search header bar styling and focus treatment
userStories.description: As a user, I want the search area to feel premium and readable (not a raw default field) so typing feels calm and delightful.
acceptanceCriteria: Search area is presented as a unified header bar consistent with the panel system
Focus state uses a subtle inner glow and thin accent stroke (no harsh focus ring)
Typography is slightly larger and improves readability
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Implemented premium focus treatment with subtle inner glow (controlAccentColor @ 0.15 alpha) and thin accent stroke (1.5px @ 0.5 alpha). Focus transitions animate smoothly (0.2s) and respect Reduce Motion accessibility setting. Typography already at 17pt from US-001.

userStories.title: Polish results list with card rows and refined selection
userStories.description: As a user, I want results rows to look like premium cards and selection to feel calm and refined so scanning and keyboard navigation is enjoyable.
acceptanceCriteria: Results rows render as subtle card-like rows while staying well-blended with the glass window
Selection style is outline + slight fill (premium/quiet) and remains clearly visible
Selection includes a very subtle, low-CPU animated stroke/opacity effect when allowed
No hover-specific styling is introduced
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Implemented premium card styling with 12px rounded corners, subtle background (controlBackgroundColor @ 0.08 alpha), and 0.5px strokes (separator @ 0.2 alpha). Selection uses thin accent outline (1.5px @ 0.6 alpha) + subtle fill (accent @ 0.12 alpha) with optional pulse animation (0.25s opacity fade). Increased row height to 44px and spacing to 6px for premium feel. Respects Reduce Motion accessibility setting.

userStories.title: Align sidecar preview styling (slightly lower contrast)
userStories.description: As a user, I want the clipboard sidecar to match the premium style but slightly recede so previews are readable without stealing focus.
acceptanceCriteria: Sidecar uses the same panel system but with slightly lower contrast than the main window
Sidecar content remains clearly readable for both text and image previews
Sidecar separation from main window is minimal and feels blended
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Implemented lower contrast sidecar styling: reduced overlay opacity (0.22→0.16), overlay stroke (0.3→0.2), content panel background (0.12→0.09), and content panel stroke (0.25→0.18). Sidecar now feels more receded and blended while maintaining clear readability for text and image previews. Snapshot test updated and passing.

userStories.title: Respect macOS accessibility settings in styling
userStories.description: As a user, I want the UI to adapt to Reduce Transparency, Increase Contrast, and Reduce Motion so it stays comfortable and usable.
acceptanceCriteria: Reduce Transparency increases surface opacity / reduces reliance on translucency
Increase Contrast strengthens strokes and selection contrast
Reduce Motion disables selection glow/pulse animations
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Update and extend snapshot coverage for new styling
userStories.description: As a developer, I want snapshot tests updated/added for the new styling so visual regressions are caught automatically.
acceptanceCriteria: Snapshot tests updated to match the new premium styling
New/updated snapshots cover: empty state, app results, clipboard results, selection, sidecar
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
